claims.evidence: One source per (cell line/SILAC channel, replicate mixture, material). TP = total proteome (24 bRPLC fractions, RT_SW48_KRAS_TP_RP0N_F01-F24), pY = anti-pY peptide IP (pY_IsogenicKRASmutants_RepN). PRIDE protocol: the pY IP used 60 mg of the mixed SILAC lysate digest per replicate and "a 600 ug aliquot of SILAC mix was also subjected to a separate in-solution tryptic digestion" for the total proteome, so TP and pY material of one replicate are separate aliquots/digests and get separate source names (precedent PXD020108), sharing the biological replicate number. The pairing TP RP0N <-> pY RepN is taken from the run-name index only.

claims.value: SILAC light = SW48 parental (KRAS wild type); SILAC medium (Arg6/Lys4) = SW48 KRAS G12D/+; SILAC heavy (Arg10/Lys8) = SW48 KRAS G13D/+; same in all 3 TP and all 3 pY mixtures
claims.evidence: No sentence in any reachable source states the label->line map (paper closed access; PRIDE protocols name the five label amino acids only). The map rests on three deposited, mutually consistent lines of evidence: (1) Genotype-specific peptides in the TP search (database explicitly supplemented with KRAS G12D and G13D, PRIDE data protocol and PD header): the G12D peptide LVVVGADGVGK was identified only with Lys4 (medium) - rep1 1 PSM, rep2 1, rep3 2 - never light or heavy; the G13D peptide LVVVGAGDVGK with Lys8 (heavy) in rep1 (1 PSM, q 2.8e-6) and rep3 (1 PSM, q 2.3e-6), never medium; one further rep3 PSM assigned light G13D (XCorr 2.80, q 1.3e-5, scan 14679, 54 scans after the heavy G13D PSM at 14625) is the only discordant hit and is outweighed; rep2 had no G13D PSM. (2) In the pY PD 2.2 study (msf AnalysisDefinition) the Light sample of each of Rep1-Rep3 is SampleType "Control" (the ratio denominator), and the PRIDE data protocol computes "G12D/Parental ratios and G13D/Parental ratios", i.e. Light = parental. (3) pY data check: MPZL1 pY263 peptide SESVVpYADIR log2 M/L +1.41/+1.30/+1.29 vs H/L -0.52/-0.68/-0.61 in Rep1/2/3 (file medians -0.52..-0.55 for both ratios), i.e. hyperphosphorylated in Medium only; the abstract states MPZL1 "was found to be hyperphosphorylated in G12D cells". The pY runs contain no KRAS peptide, so their medium/heavy assignment rests on (2)+(3) and on the protocol statement that TP is an aliquot of the same SILAC mix.

The compared variable is the KRAS allele, so it is the factor.

Three replicate SILAC mixtures (TP RP01-RP03; pY Rep1-Rep3; PRIDE: "the median values from the three replicates"); each mixture contains an independent culture per line, numbered 1..3 within each genotype group; the TP and pY aliquots of mixture N share number N.

All samples are cultured SILAC-labelled cell lines (PRIDE protocol "SILAC labeled cell pellets").

limitations: Channel map: no textual statement of which SILAC state carries which cell line exists in any reachable source (paper closed access; pubs.acs.org 403, not bypassed). The map is derived from deposited search results: KRAS G12D/G13D mutant peptides by SILAC state in the TP search (4/4 G12D PSMs medium; 2/3 G13D PSMs heavy, 1 light outlier), the PD pY study marking Light as Control, and MPZL1 pY263 up in Medium only (abstract: MPZL1 hyperphosphorylated in G12D). The pY medium/heavy assignment has no mutant-peptide evidence of its own. A reviewer applying batch rule 6 strictly (explicit statement required) may want to block these runs instead.
Pairing of TP mixture RP0N with pY mixture RepN (same biological replicate number) rests on the run-name index only.
Cellosaurus accessions CVCL_LC92 / CVCL_LC96 assume the Horizon SW48 knock-in lines, the only SW48 KRAS G12D/+ and G13D/+ entries in Cellosaurus; the paper methods (supplier) could not be read.
Culture medium, passage number, storage temperature and cell type are not available (paper closed; PRIDE protocol silent).
Reduction/alkylation reagents are not stated (carbamidomethyl search implies alkylation, reagent unknown); columns omitted.

Search database differs from the PRIDE text: PD headers show human.RefSeq84 (TP: with KRAS G12D and G13D entries; pY: plain RefSeq84), PRIDE text says RefSeq v73 + mutant KRAS. Missed cleavages 2 in PD vs "one" in PRIDE text. SDRF follows the deposited search.
pY quantification in the paper used PyQuant on the PD identifications; the SDRF only describes the PD search.
MS1 scan range / collision energy read from 5 of 75 raw headers (same method file per run type).
